_readme: One entry per output field that tools/field_check.py flags: E1 empty in PrIME, E2 agreement < 95% on the same keys, E3 source not traced. Value format: '<CATEGORY>: <measured reason> (<evidence file>)'. A reason is accepted only after the PrIME source (and its alternatives) was probed for data.

<OUTPUT_COLUMN>.empty: NO_SOURCE: <PrIME table.column> filled on 0 of <n> rows at <site>; alternatives probed: <list> (results/<probe>.json)
<OUTPUT_COLUMN>.diff: TIMING: <n> of <m> differing keys moved in RTCIS after the PrIME load (results/<probe>.json)
